body:
## What to build

**Priority: P2.** Preserve dplyr's mandatory-input refusal for an empty `pick()` in a local Margin summary. An omitted selection must not silently become a request for every available column.

At main `ac6ad79ff6026abe5fc45538d6dfefadf03a8ca3`, with a one-column tibble x containing 1 and 2, an ordinary dplyr summary that names z as the row count of empty `pick()` errors with `Must supply at least one input to pick()`. The same summary in `summarize_with_margins()` succeeds and returns z equal to 2. Qualified and redundant-parenthesis spellings and empty input reproduce the discrepancy. Explicit `pick(everything())` and explicit `pick(c())` agree with dplyr and have distinct valid meanings.

The selection reader substitutes `everything()` for a call with no arguments. A static-reader test encodes the same mistaken premise. No public documentation or ADR found during this investigation defines a separate empty-call meaning. This is a behavior correction, distinct from closed #495's behavior-preserving consolidation of the two readers.

The live dtplyr version itself accepts empty `pick()`, so do not use that backend's answer to establish the local dplyr contract. Preserve the documented handling of External conditions rather than inventing an unrelated Margin selection default.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Local empty `pick()` receives dplyr's mandatory-input refusal through named and unnamed summaries and nested ordinary expressions.
- [ ] Cover bare/qualified names, redundant parentheses, empty/nonempty local input, and an unrelated valid contextual share in the same call.
- [ ] Preserve explicit `everything()` and `c()` controls, including sequential summary selections.
- [ ] Correct the static-reader test's false empty-call premise and keep output-name analysis consistent with execution.
- [ ] Respect documented lazy-backend boundaries and their ordinary answers.
- [ ] Add public-API regressions and pass the repository's Review-ready check.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[Reproduction, controls, cause, and scoped coverage](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/c510b6a3a13b86ce22b87699b4ffda4ac32e8c95/investigation/summarize-grouping-share-bughunt-2026-10-28.md#f2-an-omitted-local-pick-selection-became-everything) were recorded in PR #956. The adjacent replay scripts target desired behavior and exit 1 on the investigated implementation. No repair was included in that PR.
title: [P2] Preserve the mandatory-input refusal for empty local pick calls
